name: Claude-BugHunter
description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 85 skills, 16 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.
one_liner: A pre-built bundle of security-testing skills and instructions you plug into Claude Code so it hunts for software bugs and security holes the way a professional penetration tester would.
buyer: A boutique security consultancy or freelance penetration tester who wants to deliver more bug-bounty and pentest reports per week without hiring more testers.
business_use_cases: A solo bug-bounty hunter runs it against authorized targets to triage dozens of candidate findings overnight instead of testing each one by hand.
A small pentest shop uses it to scaffold engagement folders and draft first-pass vulnerability reports for a client audit.
A SaaS company's internal security engineer uses it for continuous automated code review before each release.

money_ideas.idea: Offer 'AI-accelerated' pentest engagements priced below traditional manual-only firms
Sell a productized subscription to a curated, maintained version of the skill/pattern bundle

steal_this: Run it against your own side project or an authorized bug-bounty program, then use the resulting findings report as a sample to land your first paid pentest client.
